title: Compact timetable
kind: UI concept — illustrative, not a screenshot
prompt:
Create a polished NATIVE LINUX OMARCHY PRAYER PLUGIN UI CONCEPT, not a webpage. Landscape presentation image, two fully legible native popovers side by side, English left and matching Arabic right. Show a small concept title outside the popovers at top. This is a concept for the user to choose, not a real screenshot. Match the REFERENCE ONLY for its current system palette: midnight charcoal navy #162129, warm cream #EAE4D8, peach accent #F3B77B. ABSOLUTELY NO GREEN, no emerald, no clock rings or dials, no mosque imagery in the working interface, no gradients or decorative glow. English use precise JetBrains Mono-like system monospace for numbers and body, confident modest headings, no thin giant sans numerals. Arabic use beautiful Noto Kufi Arabic headings and Noto Sans Arabic body, preserve RTL. Compact sensible desktop sizing, accessible native buttons, minimal labels, enough breathing room. Compare consistent plausible data: Agadir, Morocco; Fri 6 Nov; 25 Jumada I 1448; next Asr at15:26 in28min; Fajr05:30 Sunrise06:57 Jumu'ah12:27 Asr15:26 Maghrib17:52 Isha19:04. Avoid displaying the same time or label twice. Controls only Location, Notifications, Settings, Today as appropriate. No fake features or charts. Show complete panel edges and all content. Crisp professional production-ready UI mockup.
A · Compact timetable. Each popover is about360 logical pixels wide and480 high. Header title and small language control. Single city-and-date header line. Slim next-prayer strip: 'Asr · in28min' with15:26 once; no giant hero. Below six neat timetable rows, the Asr row subtly tinted peach; do not repeat the exact time in the strip if it already appears in selected row. Show countdown only in strip and exact times only in rows. One footer with 'Location' and 'Settings' native text buttons. Dates secondary, Qibla in compact footer. This is the fastest-to-scan option.
